description: Figure 7 presents the number of questions, out of 40, with at least one factual error in chain-of-thought (CoT) responses generated by GPT3 using different methods. The horizontal axis represents the method used, labeled as “2W→HQ”, “HQ→2W”, “MQ→2W”, “2W→MQ”, and “MQ→HQ”, with each label representing a different sequence of prompts. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of questions with factual error”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 5.  The chart consists of five groups of three bars each, representing the results for “OneR”, “NoR”, and “IRCoT”. Within each group, the bars are colored blue (“OneR”), red (“NoR”), and green (“IRCoT”). For the “2W→HQ” method, the “OneR” bar reaches approximately 14, the “NoR” bar reaches approximately 20, and the “IRCoT” bar reaches approximately 16. For the “HQ→2W” method, the “OneR” bar reaches approximately 12, the “NoR” bar reaches approximately 22, and the “IRCoT” bar reaches approximately 14. For the “MQ→2W” method, the “OneR” bar reaches approximately 10, the “NoR” bar reaches approximately 24, and the “IRCoT” bar reaches approximately 12. For the “2W→MQ” method, the “OneR” bar reaches approximately 16, the “NoR” bar reaches approximately 26, and the “IRCoT” bar reaches approximately 18. For the “MQ→HQ” method, the “OneR” bar reaches approximately 18, the “NoR” bar reaches approximately 28, and the “IRCoT” bar reaches approximately 20. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each method, and the height of each bar indicates the number of questions with factual errors for that method and CoT generation approach. No bars are visually emphasized.
